message.content: Hey, I need to check my shift plan for next week. I think there’s a conflict with the new route 27 adjustments they announced yesterday.

content.text: I’ve pulled up your roster for the week of April 13th. You are scheduled for the morning shift on the 27th on Tuesday and Thursday. The system shows that route 27 has a temporary detour due to construction on Jungfernstieg. Do you want to see the specific detour details or check if you can swap shifts with someone?

message.content: The detour doesn’t bother me, but I can’t work Tuesday. I’ve got family stuff. Can you see who is available to swap with me?

content.text: I’m checking the availability of drivers qualified for route 27. There are three drivers who have requested time off on Tuesday morning. However, two of them are currently in the mandatory training phase for new drivers and aren’t yet cleared for route swaps. The third driver, Klaus, is fully qualified.

message.content: Okay, send him a request. But wait, I also need to know about the union notice regarding the overtime caps. Did that change for this month?

content.text: Yes, the union agreement update took effect on April 1st. The overtime cap for April is now set at 12 hours per driver. Your current schedule shows you have 4 hours of overtime scheduled for next week, which is well within the new limit. Would you like me to send the swap request to Klaus now?

message.content: Yes, send it. And please make sure the training drivers know they can’t be swapped in last minute. It causes too much stress.

content.text: The swap request has been sent to Klaus. He has 24 hours to accept or decline. Regarding the training drivers, the system already flags any swap involving them as 'pending supervisor approval' to prevent last-minute changes. I will add a note to your roster reminding you of the new overtime cap for your records.

message.content: Good. That’s all for now. Just keep an eye on Klaus’s response.
